readiness_note: Service readiness: not observed — Requires authorized scope, exact revision and service input contract.

Agent definition.purpose: Author a versioned agent; publishing, readiness and assignment remain distinct.

Model resource.purpose: Configure declared model capabilities; connection tests provide separate observations.

MCP server.purpose: Separate registration, discovery, grants, health and invocation.

Tool contract.purpose: Define input/output contracts and effects before granting invocation.

Sandbox template.purpose: Describe gVisor limits; actual runtime availability and cleanup require service evidence.

Agent skill.purpose: Version executable instructions and compatible runtime requirements.

Agent rule.purpose: Define enforced behavior and scope without silently changing active runs.

Agent plugin.purpose: Pin plugin artifacts, permissions and runtime compatibility.

Lifecycle hook.purpose: Bound hook execution and declare failure handling.

Runtime sidecar.purpose: Configure versioned companion services with probes and bounded resources.

Memory record.purpose: Author working, structural, episodic and semantic memory with provenance and retention.

Memory retrieval policy.purpose: Define review, promotion and bounded retrieval for a memory bank.

Context package request.purpose: Select exact, bounded context; server retrieval and submission are separate.

Repository connection.purpose: GitHub identity, permission intent, exact refs and sync policy.

Code index policy.purpose: Declare AST and semantic adapters, quality bounds and source revision.

Source query.purpose: Use exact repository/ref and bounded file, symbol and relation queries.

Document properties.purpose: Record requirements ownership, classification, review and exact relations.

Specification submission request.purpose: Submit an exact immutable set and handle supersession deliberately.

Provider credential request.purpose: Describe vault ownership, rotation and permitted model access; no keys are stored in drafts.

Model routing policy.purpose: Pin routing, fallback and circuit policy without treating a saved route as available.

Budget and reservation policy.purpose: Separate ceilings, reservations, measured usage and settlements.

Workflow definition policy.purpose: Version template ownership, explicit input/output bindings and admission policy.

Task execution contract.purpose: Bind exact dependencies, outputs, limits and checkpoint eligibility.

Run admission request.purpose: Pin approved input and policy identities; readiness, leases and reservations remain service gates.

Human checkpoint decision.purpose: Review one task attempt and exact output revision before recording a decision.

Retry / resume request.purpose: Recover using the original attempt, immutable snapshot and unresolved operation identity.

Cancel and cleanup request.purpose: Request cancellation with explicit cleanup scope; leases stay held until fencing and cleanup are verified.

Delivery review.purpose: Review exact diff and independent risk/security/test evidence.

Pull request and merge request.purpose: Target the exact repository/head and reconcile conditional merge outcomes.

Post-merge acceptance.purpose: Record a case-specific independent oracle against the actual merged revision.

Membership invitation.purpose: Bind intended identity, scope, role and expiry; acceptance must verify the signed-in account.

Role and grant policy.purpose: Explain scoped grants and inheritance without letting a draft grant access.

Access revocation request.purpose: Review memberships, active runs and ownership transfer before revocation.

Organization.purpose: Organization ownership, locale, regional and retention intent.

Workspace.purpose: Bind workspace ownership to its parent organization and inherited policy.

Project onboarding.purpose: Track repository, required specs and readiness dependencies separately.

Archive / transfer / deletion request.purpose: Review dependency holds, retention and the intended owner before a protected operation.

Scoped configuration override.purpose: Retain parent provenance and revision guards; deployments verify the effective result.

Runtime capability policy.purpose: Declare supported environment, scheduler, sandbox and output limits.

Anchored discussion.purpose: Bind review comments to exact document revision and stable anchors.

Durable collaboration cut request.purpose: Record expected room epoch, update closure and exact document set.

Subscription and seats request.purpose: Describe requested seats and quotas; service billing observations remain authoritative.

Billing reconciliation request.purpose: Reconcile the original reservation, usage or charge identity before another mutation.

Data export / erasure request.purpose: Scope tenant data and retention exceptions; fulfillment requires a protected job and verified result.

Desktop device binding.purpose: Bind one device and local repository to authorized scope; capabilities must be advertised.

Companion update request.purpose: Check exact package digest and compatible platform before update or rollback.

Telemetry query.purpose: Specify units, freshness, environment and bounded trace/log/metric/profile selection.

Diagnostic export request.purpose: Bound a public diagnostic projection and its expiry; protected downloads require server authorization.

Incident and operations handoff.purpose: Preserve original identity, scope, symptoms and recovery ownership.
